detail: Columbia University’s architectural catalog records a dome span of 12.5 m and a height of 24.5 m.
The Aga Khan architectural inventory documents the northwest-southeast orientation, tall eight-sided supporting system, raised basement and paired minarets.

The documented building description records six half-domes, eighteen courtyard arcade domes, three fan-shaped approach stairs, arched outer galleries, one balcony per minaret and an eight-column fountain canopy.
Municipal heritage record confirms the extant 18th-century complex and its combination of Ottoman classical and baroque design.
